### Counterfeit laser hair removal and therapy devices found in some clinics and may pose serious health risks
*Health Canada - Health Products Alerts & Recalls · Canada · ★★★★☆*

Health Canada is advising Canadians about counterfeit laser hair removal machines and therapy systems sold under the “Soprano” brand. The authentic Soprano devices are manufactured by Alma Lasers Ltd.
